commonPrompt: Photorealistic premium catalogue photograph; landscape 3:2; centred subject; realistic materials; restrained green/gold accents; no branding, people, UI, prices or watermark.

assets.prompt: An unbranded platinum and rose-gold mechanical wristwatch with a deep emerald dial, realistically detailed hands, polished case and articulated metal bracelet, on a dark stone display plinth. Full watch visible at a three-quarter angle.

An unbranded emerald-cut green gemstone pendant surrounded by small clear diamonds, suspended from a fine warm-gold chain draped on a charcoal velvet jewellery stand. Realistic facets and restrained luxury.
An elegant unbranded long-wheelbase black luxury limousine, complete car visible in a three-quarter front view, parked on a quiet stone driveway outside a refined modern hotel at dusk.

A sleek white 45-metre private motor yacht, full vessel visible in a three-quarter view, moored in calm turquoise Mediterranean water with distant rocky coastline. Realistic hull, railings, decks and reflections.

A refined contemporary coastal mansion with natural limestone walls, broad glazing, a palm-framed infinity pool and sea beyond at golden hour. Entire main house clearly visible, believable architectural photography.

An immaculate private coastal golf course: curved fairway, carefully raked pale sand bunkers, a putting green and a small understated clubhouse in the distance. Realistic aerial landscape photography in warm afternoon light.

An unbranded elegant white private business jet with a subtle dark green stripe, complete aircraft including both wings visible, parked on a clean airport apron at golden hour. Realistic aviation photography.

A beautiful small private tropical island surrounded by turquoise water and coral shallows, with palm trees, a few discreet luxury villas and a slender wooden jetty. Realistic oblique aerial photography, whole island visible.

A realistic reusable winged orbital space shuttle, complete vehicle visible on a quiet illuminated launch facility apron at blue hour. White thermal tiles, black underside and metallic details, generic fictional operator, technically plausible proportions.
assets.edit: Removed incidental fuselage lettering while preserving the scene.
